thermal._option: Baseline +5 C is the owner decision (contract power.thermal_policy.head_setpoint_c, draft9). It is on the safe side for dark counts: the electronics' default LLD of 10 p.e. (STAGE2_CHANGE_REQUESTS.md S3-10) was derived for the +10 C dark rate, and the dark rate falls with temperature (halving about every 8 C, head_afe_budget.md section 3.2). The OEM carrier / bond-line limits are still unknown (RFQ). +10 C is kept only as a comparison case.
